method: Area-weighted barycentric sampling of the actual cortex, visibility-filtered in the reference-facing bilateral pose, with interpolated normals. Centered and uniformly scaled with one rigid orientation transform. No ellipsoid approximation.

pose.description: Near frontal, slight downward view, both hemispheres and central fissure visible.

depthMesh.purpose: Original cortex geometry for depth occlusion and quiet surface shading.
